tbesh_html:
1) lily
1a) probably any lily-like flower
1b) Shoshannim, in title of Ps 45:1

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a lily (from its whiteness), as aflower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
strongs_1890.derivation: or שׁוֹשָׁן; or שֹׁשָׁן; and (feminine) שׁוֹשַׁנָּה; from H7797 (שׂוּשׂ);
